title: Direwolf Packet Decode Error Rate
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=direwolf:packet
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as attempts count(eval(decode_status="ok")) as successful by _time tnc_port
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for Direwolf packet decodes by TNC port.
value: A decode success percentage catches antenna, audio, or level problems before the APRS map obviously empties out.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for Direwolf packet decodes events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for Direwolf packet decodes by TNC port.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often Direwolf packet decodes works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
